purpose: Join EML-visible runtime resource type identifiers with local KFC resource metadata.
inputs: same-build KFC type and resource indexes

matching_policy.direct_name_match: allowed only when namespaces are explicitly identical
matching_policy.unmatched: retain as boundary evidence; do not infer absence

limitations: EML Type identifiers may use a namespace different from KFC folder names.
A zero direct-match result is not evidence that runtime types are absent from KFC.
Bridge records require same-build provenance and an independently verified mapping.
